_comment: Forex universe — ISO with systematic-tss forex-majors sleeve (config/portfolio_multi_survivors.yaml alloc forex-majors, forex_universe). Go restricts the ForexScanner to exactly these 8 majors via SetForexUniverse; buildForexYahooSymbols appends the =X Yahoo suffix. Keep in sync with that config: any extra/exotic pair (USDSEK, USDKRW, USDMAD, EM crosses…) evicts the majors from the top-N rank and breaks ISO parity.
